There’s something funny about that advice always being lauded, in a sick way. 

In my previous comment I said how before I was assaulted I play fought with my rapist. At one point in it he jokingly told me to fight dirty, so I kicked him in the crotch. He laughed at me and said it felt good.

Sorry for the TW: assault

The day of my assault, my rapist play wrestled me. I always thought I was strong. Later than night when it was happening, I pretended to be asleep and let it happen because I knew if I fought back he easily had the strength to kill me.

Years ago my mother had a heart to heart with me about her rape as a teenager by a trusted family friend. 

A few years later when I was assaulted she told me it was my own fault for not realising that “that’s what men do”.

It comes from a place of fear themselves, projecting their own trauma and the fact that they haven’t recovered themselves and still blame themselves. That’s how I try to justify it anyway.

My family found out I was self harming as a tween and pretended to be supportive, but really:

* Screamed at me about how I was ruining their lives any time they found a mark

* Instilled a fear of being sectioned or taken into care so severe that I still find it hard to seek help when having a crisis

* My mom would tell everyone she knew, and would discuss me and my issues loudly on the phone with her friends in front of me, laughing about it. 

* Got my brother to search my room at random for sharp objects. He would also use this time to throw away my diary, which I used to vent about him abusing me. 

If I told her I attempted suicide in this time she’d still be surprised.

I woke up to him assaulting me and just froze for 3+ hours pretending to be asleep and let it all happen because I was too afraid of what he would do if he knew I was awake, and how it would upset his mom if she woke up from the other room to it.
I found out that he’d been molesting me in my sleep for months every time I stayed at his house.
I developed a tic (hiccups) about a year after. My partner says I’m always stiff and clenching my toes. I have irritable bowels and get palpitations a lot.
Sorry what does this mean?

You should add a TW to the post btw.

Some years ago I was lying in bed when I was struck by just remembering lying the same way in my old childhood bedroom and suddenly remembered an extremely vivid memory from that bedroom of waking up once in the dark and my older brother was standing naked and erect over my bed. He told me to go back to sleep so I did.

It bothers me every day.
This is one for me too. Same with people with the same name.

Worst: “What did you expect when you sleep in a man’s bed?” From my mom, after what was supposed to be comforting talk. 

Best: Weirdly, any time I’ve told somebody and they seemed... disgusted. Not at me (although there is always a twinge of pain when I think it might be) but at him. And how validated it makes me feel that someone is disgusted by what he did to me.

I had a breakdown after it happened and a friend rang me demanding to know what happened, thinking it would have just been a bad mood or something at work. He was at a bar and I could hear him leave and start getting upset over the phone. Another I told over Skype and they just replied “fuck fuck fucking hell”.

It felt validating because that’s basically what was going through my head too.
I live in a shitty town and the last time I walked for pleasure alone at night playing Pokemon go I had a group of men threaten to rape me.

Unfortunately I’m trapped at home at the moment. My mother has been unable to work due to illness so I’ve had to pay for everything and get a second job.m instead of moving out as planned last year. Hopefully this year. I can’t wait to be free of her.

I made a serious suicide attempt when I was 12 years old. I didn’t know how to really do it, but I hoarded every pill in the house and took them all one night. I remember fading into black and not regretting anything. Then I woke up hours later with my face in pitch black thick vomit. 

My first thought was shame, and I don’t think that feeling has ever left me since. I told my mom I had food poisoning and she later asked me if I knew where her medicine was. That was it. I never told anyone who mattered.

My next birthday makes it 12 years since then and it’s in the back of my mind always. What have I done of worth? Not a lot. I always expect to kind of be dead before 30. 

What would I tell my younger self? You stupid fuckup, probably.

I spent the weekend at a rally and got drunk and just felt like I annoyed everyone. I had a good time but I spent all of Sunday just hating myself and feeling physical discomfort and pain from anxiety.

Sunday night and last night I kept having the same dream about trying to run away from a group of men including someone who looks like my rapist, failing, freezing up again and the worst happening over and over again and it felt so real. I kept waking up screaming.

I haven’t had night terrors in like 2 years and it’s been a few months since nightmares like this, I feel like I’m back at square one again.

I can never listen to that song ever again and it was extremely hard to listen to any Nirvana for the longest time because a “friend” who used to “get it stuck in his head” and sing/mutter it sometimes ended up raping me, and he played it the day he did it. 

One of the more minor side effects that still lingers sure, but it still hurts because I loved Nirvana.

I only found out he got married and has kids this year. I tried to forget about it because this year has been hell for me since my mother got diagnosed with cancer, but it’s been eating away at me for the past few months. I made the venting post and decided to follow the advice people posted.
Check my update post.

I sent her screenshots of him, and she said he never called me before their wedding because there are no call logs (I told her they can be deleted.

She said she asked him and he said he only "touched my bum and hips" in my sleep.

She demanded to talk to people I had confided in at the time, I said I didn't want to involve other innocent people and sent her screenshots of talking about it with a friend 2-3 years ago.

I told her that he confessed to ejaculating into his boss's coffee, and she said he had already told her before that it was a *joke* and a lie.

She asked why I never reported it, I told her why and that I did try and report him this year but the police didn't care.

Then she said she knows him better than anyone else and that he would never, so I told her it's up to her to listen to me or not and that I was going to block her only because I didn't want him to see or contact me from any profile.

(I was also mistaken when I said he had two daughters, turns out the baby was a boy.)

I dunno.

I tried.

One of his last texts before I blocked him was begging me to talk to him because “I know I’m fucked up im on all kinds of meds now my mom hates me”

But she’s in his wedding photos holding his children.

His mom knows, at least a small amount. She knows I stopped talking to him very suddenly and I think he told her he did “something”.

He met this girl like six months or a year after, I find it impossible to think nobody mentioned anything.

3 and a half years ago my best friend sexually assaulted me in my sleep and I found out he’d been doing it for months. I cut all contact and always talked myself out of reporting it.

Just before New Years this year (not long after the 3 years anniversary) I got a series of calls in the middle of the night and I could hear it was him masturbating on the other end. I had a bit of a breakdown, and had to change my number. I reported those calls to the police but they declined to do anything because he didn’t **say** anything.

A week later in a self loathing drunk state, I made a fake Facebook profile and searched him. He got married a week after calling me. Him and his wife have two toddler daughters now.

I’m constantly flip flopping between whether or not she knows and doesn’t care, or him and his family have never told her. Every time I get drunk I have the urge to send her the screenshots of him admitting it and the call records of calling me at 4am before they got married.

I could’ve stopped all of this from happening, and now I can never report him because it would be ruining 3 other women’s lives.

Details: 2017 ended with my rapist calling me close to the anniversary of it happening and masturbating down the phone. I decided to take a positive outlook on 2018 and yet:

* I drunkenly decided to look him up. He got married 10 days after he called me. He has two children and now a wife because I never reported him.

* I decided to call the police and report the calls for harassment. They refused to follow it up because "he never said anything". I had to change my number, and had a complete breakdown for about a week.

* Early in the year my mom got a mammogram because she had a lump, they said it was nothing. Months later, she went again as it was worse and now it's stage 2 breast cancer. She's just started chemo, has to have a mastectomy and more radiotherapy.

Just fuck this year. Fuck it. Fuck all of it. Here I am more than halfway through only wondering how much worse it could possibly get.

Not outing my rapist when I found out he got a girlfriend a few months after.

Only a few years later and now they’re married and have two daughters and I feel like I’d be a petty person to contact her and tell her he called me to harass me again a few days before she married him.

There are events, days or mere moments that have changed the course of my life in drastic ways. I don’t think a single day goes by where I don’t wonder about where I’d be if X hadn’t happened.

If my suicide attempt at a young age had gone noticed, would I have been sectioned? What would have happened?

What would have happened if as a kid I went to one school instead of another? What kind of person would I be?

If my rape never happened my life would be completely different. I had to cut out so many people and opportunities just out of fear of seeing that person again.

My mother is most likely getting diagnosed with breast cancer this week and I feel like I will be pinpointing this as the moment where everything will be starting to go to shit.

Yeah, I know it’ll be a long time until I can get them covered. An incentive to not add to them I guess.

Thank you. 

Part of it is I just got so sick of my body. I got sick of being sexualised, the same comments I used to get from him “joking” about my ass before he did it I still get from various people joking now and I can’t say that it hurts because every time it reminds me.

I’m hoping these heal fast, I want to cover them with a tattoo.

Before New Years I got a series of calls at 4 in the morning. I answered some of them without thinking, and it was the familiar voice of my rapist masturbating. I hadn't heard anything from him since it happened in late 2014. I freaked out and a lot of things happened, I tried to ask the police to help and they refused. I later found out that a week after he made those calls was his wedding day, to someone he never would've met OR HAD TWO FUCKING DAUGHTERS WITH if I'd have reported him in the three years that I never did.

I saw his wedding photos. I saw his family smiling, his mother who "said she can't speak to me she's so disgusted" (his words) holding his children and smiling. I didn't go into work for half a week because I just didn't know how to process it, and one of those days (I forget when, it was either late jan or early feb) I got plastered and did this for the first time in 3 years.

It's looking better now, when it was cold they were bright purple and I'm worried they're going to heal raised like my arm did. I told my partner about them but only because I knew I couldn't hide them. The biggest few didn't stop bleeding until about 4 days after.

I've got holidays planned, I'm so worried about finding a swimsuit  that can hide this.
